{{Top|leg}}
The '''Infrared Motion Sensor Array''' was the technology used on the alarm system of [[Creshaldyne Industries/Legends|Creshaldyne Industries's]] [[Cresh Luck armor/Legends|Cresh Luck armor]].<ref name="all">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', [[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', {{WEGCite|story=Heavy Lifting|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>

It was an early-warning system using [[infrared motion tracker]]s to give an audio or visual alarm. It was default to audio but it could be configured to sound only inside a blast helmet, or to be only inner visual.<ref name="GG">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', [[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> It had a range of 30 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and it was activated should a mass of over 10 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] was found traveling in the radio faster than 1 meter per second,<ref name="all" /> which was understood as an attack.<ref name="GG" />
